selection_basis: The complete four-cycle-view inventory exhausted current schedule coverage, and transpose supplies every additional maze solve. Extending that productive trajectory changes the candidate inventory and tests whether four-cycle truncation hides useful later answers.
source: same 128 consumed examples per family and two frozen model seeds per family
new_trajectory: transpose from zero state for 32 cycles, retaining every answer and checking original-input validity independently
costs: Full online input transform, native checker construction, embedding/reset, recursion, decoding and original-input verification are timed. All seven arms are paired; all outcomes and failed comparisons retained.
decision: Report quality and complete cost against every comparator. A faster same-quality configuration on consumed data remains a selected development result. The original failure-information quality gate is unchanged.
claims: This tests static depth allocation and candidate-generation headroom, not learned failure feedback or a novel algorithm. No independent confirmation, classical superiority, energy, hiring or level claim.
